description: Drive the page toward a goal in one call (fill and submit a form, log in, pick filters, step through a wizard): each step reads the visible controls, asks the judge worker which operation (click, type, select, scroll, wait, done, blocked) and which element, acts, and waits for the requests the action started, until the judge says done or blocked, a field needs text you did not give in `inputs`, nothing changes three times, or the step/time budget runs out. State the goal as the end state to reach ("logged in: the dashboard shows"), not the clicks. Returns the steps taken and the final page table; read it before reporting success, done is the judge's reading, not proof (a login can end on an error). Without a judge worker it returns status judge_unavailable with the page table: drive with browser::elements and browser::act instead.

goal.description: The end state to reach, as the page would show it ("logged in: the dashboard shows", "the bug is saved and listed"), not the clicks to make. Name every value the outcome needs.

inputs.description: Text for fields the goal needs filled: `{"email": "…", "password": "…"}`. A key reaches a field by its `n` ref, by its label (case, accents and punctuation ignored: `email` for "E-mail"), by what the field is (input type, `name`, `autocomplete`: `password` for a password field labelled "Senha"), or as the only key the label contains. Only the keys are shown to the judge.

max_steps.description: Most actions to execute (default 10, at most 60).

timeout_ms.description: Whole-run budget in ms (default 30000), clamped to `max_timeout_ms`.

page.description: The page as the run left it (`browser::elements` shape).

Element.description: One control. `operations` says what `browser::act` can do with it.

label.description: Accessible name (aria-labelledby, aria-label, label, text, title, or placeholder).

more_options.description: Options beyond the listed 50; `select` still accepts them by label.

ref.description: `n` ref `browser::act` accepts; valid while the element stays in this document.

value.description: Current value of a field or dropdown; a set password reads `(set)`.

busy.description: The page is still loading: the document, a region marked `aria-busy`, or (in `browser::run`) requests an action started that had not finished when the run stopped waiting.

elements.description: Visible, enabled controls inside the viewport, in document order.

generation.description: Document generation; navigation advances it and every `n` ref dies.

omitted.description: Controls past the 250-element cap, not listed.

text.description: Visible text in the viewport, up to 6000 characters.

input_keys.description: The `inputs` keys the run was given, none of which matched this field.

oneOf.description: The judge chose DONE and its completion check rated the goal complete on the page. Verify on `page`; it is the judge's reading, not proof.
The judge found no operation that makes progress.
Three executed steps in a row changed nothing.
A field must be typed and no `inputs` entry matches it: type it with `browser::act` (or rerun with `inputs`), then run again.
No usable judge (not deployed, no provider, or failing). Drive with `browser::elements` + `browser::act`; `page` is the current table.

error.description: Why the action was refused or failed; the page was re-read and the judge asked again.

operation.description: CLICK, TYPE_TEXT, SELECT, SCROLL_UP, SCROLL_DOWN or WAIT.

probability.description: The judge's probability for the executed choice.
